places: Volcan Tajumulco (highest point in Central America)

fields.climate: tropical; hot, humid in lowlands; cooler in highlands
fields.terrain: two east-west trending mountain chains divide the country into three regions: the mountainous highlands, the Pacific coast south of mountains, and the vast northern Peten lowlands
fields.hazards: numerous volcanoes in mountains, with occasional violent earthquakes; Caribbean coast extremely susceptible to hurricanes and other tropical storms; volcanism: significant volcanic activity in the Sierra Madre range…
fields.resources: petroleum, nickel, rare woods, fish, chicle, hydropower
fields.farm: sugarcane, bananas, oil palm fruit, maize, cantaloupes/melons, potatoes, milk, tomatoes, chicken, pineapples
fields.exports: garments, bananas, coffee, palm oil, raw sugar
fields.industries: sugar, textiles and clothing, furniture, chemicals, petroleum, metals, rubber, tourism
fields.languages: Spanish (official) 69.9%, Maya languages 29.7% (Q'eqchi' 8.3%, K'iche 7.8%, Mam 4.4%, Kaqchikel 3%, Q'anjob'al 1.2%, Poqomchi' 1%, other 4%), other 0.4% (includes Xinca and Garifuna)
fields.legal: civil law system; judicial review of legislative acts
fields.military: 18-28 for voluntary service for men and women (17-21 for military schools); all Guatemalan men 18-49 are subject to selective compulsory service; service obligation is 12-24 months
